current_activity: taking over westward attack toward Saint-Sauveur-le-Vicomte
notes: Took over main westward attack with 82nd Airborne on 14 June (Maj. Gen. Manton Eddy); bridgehead at Sainte-Colombe/Saint-Sauveur.
3rd Bn 60th Infantry reached Barneville-sur-Mer early 18 June; 47th cut the La Haye-du-Puits road at Grande Huanville late 17 June; isolated Cherbourg garrison; 77th Div column destroyed.
47th Infantry fighting in the south-west suburbs 25 June; 39th/47th at Octeville and Equeurdreville.

current_activity: attacking up Cap de la Hague
notes: 9th Division, relieved of Cherbourg duties, attacked up Cap de la Hague on 29 June (47th on north coast, 60th in centre, 4th Cavalry Group on left).

current_activity: the 39th Infantry moves in on the rear of the Wahlerscheid pillboxes early on 1 February
notes: Event date: 1 February 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 3 p. 65-66: the 9th Division repulsed a counterattack a few hundred yards from the Wahlerscheid road junction late on 31 January; its 39th Infantry moved in on the rear of the pillboxes early on 1 February). Event definition: the division takes the Wahlerscheid road junction with the 2d Division; the row is the regiment's action. Relationship: V Corps unspecified_subordination (from 18 Dec 44 to 16 Feb 45, CMH table); First Army assigned (from 20 Nov 43, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 1 Aug 44, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. The earlier unspecified_subordination relation to VII Corps (CR0236) is closed at 17 December 1944 (inferred_from_next_claim); see the Review note on it. Location: Wahlerscheid road junction in the Monschau Forest. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap Nominatim (Wahlerscheid, Monschau, Germany). Event support: moderate (single Green Book passage). Location support: moderate (named junction).
